findings.decision: Bretonnia is a broad, highly decentralized cultural and geographic region analogous to medieval Europe, not a unified state. It contains multiple kingdoms, duchies, lordships and other politically independent or semi-independent lands. Its peoples are tied together by a shared chivalric tradition, religion, language/cultural sphere and customs. King Charles III is one of Bretonnia's major kings, not King of all Bretonnia.
